title: Task Management
summary: An offline-first, ADHD-friendly app for capturing ideas and turning them into doable tasks. Projects hold context, while capacity check-ins and commitments help shape the day without making a missed date a dead end.

title: Travel Planner
summary: A flexible place for bookings, activities, maps, and destination ideas. Itineraries can hold alternatives instead of locking every hour down, with live events and a trip journal planned as it grows.

title: Webhaven
summary: A web exploration game where domains and pages become settlements. Explorers collect discoveries into topic-based communities, and the knowledge they find takes the form of residents in a growing world.

title: Fantasy Baseball
summary: A pixel-art battle game that turns weekly fantasy baseball matchups into character fights. Player performance becomes moves and health; the first game loop will use mock data while Yahoo integration waits.
